jobs.title: .NET Developer | Senior
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a Senior .NET Developer to join an IT team in the banking sector, supporting systems used to monitor trading activity, strengthen compliance controls and identify potential fraud or operational anomalies. This opportunity is based in Porto, in a hybrid work model, and focuses on back-end development, data-oriented analysis, application modernization and software robustness.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Develop, maintain and optimize back-end applications supporting monitoring, control and compliance-related processes.
- Contribute to the modernization of existing systems, including architecture improvement, technical upgrades and robustness initiatives.
- Design and improve database components, including complex stored procedures, views and data structures.
- Support the implementation of automated testing frameworks to increase application quality and maintainability.
- Apply secure development practices and contribute to DevSecOps adoption within the software delivery lifecycle.
- Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders in an agile environment to analyze requirements and deliver reliable solutions.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 6 to 9 years of professional experience in .NET development, with strong autonomy in complex application environments.
- Proven ability to improve application robustness, maintainability and technical architecture.
- Analytical mindset, with the ability to understand data flows, business rules and operational control requirements.
- Initiative, ownership and the ability to contribute to modernization and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Professional working proficiency in English, minimum B2 level.
- Collaborative, responsible and solution-oriented approach aligned with agile delivery practices.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

- C#
- .NET
- .NET Framework
- SQL
- Database architecture
- Complex stored procedures and views
- RESTful APIs
- SOLID principles
- Design patterns
- Automated testing frameworks
- Agile methodologies
- DevSecOps practices

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience in compliance, anti-fraud, trading, financial markets or control-oriented systems.
- Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices applied to software development.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Private health insurance from day one, with no waiting periods and optional family extension.
- Access to confidential mental health support, content and live sessions through TEAM 24.
- Continuous training and certification opportunities to support structured professional growth.
- Flexibility whenever the role and project context allow it, supporting sustainable performance and daily balance.
- Team moments, shared milestones and leadership presence that strengthen collaboration and belonging.
- Upskilling opportunities in quality management, information security, AI governance and cybersecurity best practices.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Hexa is committed to equal opportunity and inclusive hiring. We value different backgrounds, perspectives and experiences, and we align our practices with the principles of the Portuguese Diversity Charter.

HEXA LIFE

At Hexa, every professional is a Builder. You will be part of a culture based on honesty, mutual support and agility, where people are encouraged to contribute, improve and build meaningful solutions together.

A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!

A nossa missão é ser uma parte significativa da carreira das nossas pessoas. À medida que crescemos, cresce também a determinação em oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos colaboradores e clientes e é exatamente isso que nos move. Somos uma empresa portuguesa de consultoria tecnológica
com escritórios em Lisboa, Porto e Óbidos
e representações no Brasil e Tunísia
. Contamos com mais de 14 anos de expertise no mercado
, e hoje somos um universo de cerca de 400 pessoas a trabalhar em contexto presencial, remoto ou híbrido em projetos em +20 países
.

Acreditamos que grandes pessoas fazem empresas de sucesso e por isso mesmo defendemos a valorização, reconhecimento e crescimento dos nossos profissionais.

Não queremos ser mais uma linha do teu CV, queremos que connosco vivas uma Lifetime Experience
. Apostamos em formações e certificações que confirmam a tua real progressão, na promoção de um saudável work-life balance e na oferta de benefícios com impacto na tua vida pessoal e carreira.

#welcometoyourfuture

O Que Procuramos

Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência prática em desenvolvimento .NET.
Sólida experiência com Microsoft .NET (C#/.NET Framework/.NET Core).
Conhecimento básico a intermédio de desenvolvimento e manutenção em OutSystems.
Sólido conhecimento de SQL Server, incluindo otimização de queries e resolução de problemas.
Experiência com Git/GitHub e práticas de desenvolvimento colaborativo.
Experiência na conceção e consumo de APIs REST e SOAP.
Experiência na integração de aplicações empresariais e sistemas de terceiros.
Experiência na utilização prática de ferramentas de IA Generativa (Copilot, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot ou similares) para acelerar o desenvolvimento de software, apoiar atividades de teste, melhorar a documentação técnica e aumentar a produtividade da equipa.

Ser Affinity

#Affinidade – Criares relações de proximidade e empatia com colegas, clientes e candidatos (e não apenas com tecnologias, linguagens e plataformas). Espírito de equipa e boa disposição;
#Ambição – Quereres fazer mais e melhor. Vontade de exceder expectativas e evoluir pessoal e profissionalmente;
#Ação – Energia para fazer acontecer. Mostrares proatividade e capacidade de iniciativa;
#Aprendizagem – Vontade de evoluir individual e coletivamente e tornares-te um expert no mercado tecnológico;
#Assertividade – Comunicação transparente e honesta, sempre com feedback construtivo.

A tua

Participar em projetos nacionais e internacionais numa empresa baseada em relacionamentos pessoais, na simplicidade e na eficiência, com uma ação disruptiva no mercado tecnológico;
Aceder a um plano de carreira e formação personalizado e diretamente proporcional ao teu desempenho e interesse;
Fazer parte de um ambiente acolhedor, de confiança, respeito e informalidade;
Integrar as nossas Affinity Communities (de desporto, tecnologia, hobbies, etc.) e participar ativamente em projetos de responsabilidade social e ambiental;
Tirar partido de um conjunto de benefícios, parcerias, descontos eventos e dinâmicas internas.

Para além da tua satisfação profissional queremos proporcionar-te oportunidades de lazer e convívio memoráveis e dignos de uma experiência Affinity.

jobs.description:
Unleash innovation — architect tomorrow’s enterprise solutions with power and precision!

Porto-based
opportunity with hybrid
work model

As a Senior .NET Developer
, you will be working for our client, a forward-thinking leader in the technology industry dedicated to delivering robust, scalable, and innovative software solutions. You will play a crucial role in designing, upgrading, and optimizing applications that empower businesses to stay ahead in a competitive landscape. Join us and be part of a journey that pushes technical boundaries and drives digital transformation.

Your main responsibilities:

Design and develop high-quality, scalable .NET applications following best practices and architectural standards
Enhance and upgrade existing applications to ensure optimal performance, security, and maintainability
Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and views for efficient data processing
Establish and maintain automated testing frameworks to ensure code quality and reliability
Collaborate with cross-functional teams using agile methodologies to deliver innovative solutions
Integrate RESTful APIs to enable seamless data and service communication
Apply SOLID principles and design patterns to create flexible and maintainable code
Participate in code reviews, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives

You're ideal for this role if you have:

6+ years of professional experience in software development, with a strong focus on C# and .NET technologies
Proven expertise in SQL, including database architecture and complex query optimization
Hands-on experience in developing and working with RESTful APIs
Solid understanding of SOLID principles and design patterns
Experience working in agile environments
Fluent in English, with Portuguese language skills considered a plus

It is a strong plus if you have:

Certifications related to .NET or software architecture
Experience with automated testing tools and frameworks

Language Required for the role:

English (Fluent), Portuguese (Conversational/Fluent preferred)

Eligibility to work on this role:

Only candidates with an existing legal right to work in the European Union will be considered for this role.

Interested? Apply now and include your CV (preferably in English) along with a statement confirming your consent to the processing and storage of your personal data.
